Best Event Venues in Mohali — VR Productions Venue Guide

Nov 25, 2024 • 7 min read • By VR Productions

Mohali has grown into a vibrant event destination with world-class venues that rival even Chandigarh's finest. Here's our complete guide to Mohali's best event venues, based on years of working across all major properties.

Premium Venues in Mohali

Lagoona Club, Sector 116 — Mohali's most exclusive event venue with stunning outdoor lawns and indoor banquet halls.

Radisson Blu, Sector 76 — international brand standards with flexible event spaces for corporate and social events.

Hyatt Place, Aerocity — convenient for airport-adjacent events with modern conference and banquet facilities.

Farmhouses in Mohali

Phase 8 and Phase 10 in Mohali host several premium farmhouses with landscaped gardens, swimming pools, and accommodation — perfect for destination weddings.

Sports Venue Events in Mohali

IS Bindra PCA Cricket Stadium grounds and surrounding areas can host large-scale outdoor events for 5,000+ attendees.
